notes.title: Cards We're Dealt Directors Cut Update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Cards We're Dealt 1.0.4.8 
[/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722029/4b6f77b12f5a7ad9870065e3ad4d08b2846f4643.gif"][/img]
[/p][p][i]Directors Cut Part IV[/i] is here! This concludes all remaining changes I wanted to make to the game for the time being! The game will launch everywhere next month.
[/p][p] [b]Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Cards We're Dealt Prologue now available for free on Xbox as a demo [/p][/*][*][p]Added parking garage floor in "Escape"[/p][/*][*][p]Added new animation for players tripping[/p][/*][*][p]Fix game settings and stats not resetting when restarting from lobby menu[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug fixes
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722029/e22295a5d67d9b27430472cf6bfdc0eb28efd04d.gif"][/img][/p][p]
Hope you all appreciated the journey as much as me.
Next time you hear from me the game will be out on Playstation. 
Back to work on Tiny Planet... 
Love you. Appreciate everyone's patience. 

Thanks for playing, 

Cole[/p][p]

notes.title: Cards We're Dealt Demo – Patch Notes 1.0.1.1
notes.notes:
[h2]New CWD update 👀 🃏 [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722029/6d214a3dba4c02742be4df0090d796d60e1e0ef4.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] New Customize Menu
[*] New Story Menu
[*] Generation Fixes
[*] Fix enemies spawning too close or too far away
[*] fix when being killed you cant use cards
[*] rework enemy AI for better stealth
[*] Crouch can now be used to hide under tables
[*] crouch sounds
[*] new song "Desperate" added
[*] Change the step sound effect rate
[*] fix reset the ability bar on death
[*] Add loading icon
[*] cut away way earlyier on death
[*] fix keyboard and controller swapping
[*] fix while moving messes up the cards screen on controller
[/list]

Love you. 
Thanks for playing,

 Cole

notes.title: Cards We're Dealt Demo – Patch Notes 1.0.0.7
notes.notes:
[h2]First major CWD update 👀 🃏 [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722029/cffc27b71d45782629df0e92ffe5368a0d48a049.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Added more scenery to walls
[*] Fix an endless loading situation
[*] Added a brightness adjust
[*] Projector room added (Map)
[*] Improved card pickup detection
[*] Added popup telling you, you cant move dark cards
[*] Fixed customize text on menu
[*] Made sprint more dramatically good
[*] Made it easier to pick up cards
[*] Let people blink through enemies
[*] Fixed “no keycards” pops up if spamming after entering keycards
[*] Give the keycard animation more time before transition
[*] Add Playstation buttons to prompts
[*] Fix stair collisions so you can run back up them in tutorial and so you can easily run up them in stair rooms
[*] Change bottom floor of tutorial to be easier staggering the enemies
[/list]

Love you. 
Thanks for playing,

 Cole
